review.rationale: 两项回答补齐小数、倒置和抽样超上限边界；两版保留真实hash和25/20/30阈值，统一随机逐槽独立，不以超上限原样本算增益。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 回合结束按当前/已损体力计算m/n并四舍五入，按较小到较大端点含两端逐槽各抽一次，超过原技能PP上限即钳制；保留当前PP降低保护；按实际总PP与实际已损授盾罩、下回合免异/固粉增伤，命中PP/神游行为保持。

success.name: 4902两版20/25/30阈值四个实际总和20/25/30/35分开检验，强化版30同时授盾罩而原版只有罩
success.assertion: test('4902两版20/25/30阈值四个实际总和20/25/30/35分开检验，强化版30同时授盾罩而原版只有罩',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const value of[4,5,6,7]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:value*200},hp:value*100,loadout:[20267,38388,29349,29350,38390]});turn(s);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1);assert.equal(event.sum,value*5);assert.equal(event.barrier,value*5>=(id===2089?25:20));assert.equal(event.shield,value*5<=(id===2089?25:30));}});

success.name: 4902真实2089与2105整数固定区间独立重设五槽，25恰等时两类同时成立且按真实总PP/已损PP授盾罩
success.assertion: test('4902真实2089与2105整数固定区间独立重设五槽，25恰等时两类同时成立且按真实总PP/已损PP授盾罩',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1000},hp:500});turn(s);const f=s.fighters[0],event=f.soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1),missing=f.moves.reduce((n,k)=>n+s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-5,0);assert.deepEqual(f.moves.map(k=>f.pp[k]),[5,5,5,5,5]);assert.equal(event.sum,25);assert.equal(event.barrier,true);assert.equal(event.shield,true);assert.equal(f.suitState.barrier,250);assert.equal(f.suitState.shield,missing*10);assert.equal(f.effects['免异常'].start,2);assert.equal(f.effects['免异常'].end,2);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存',()=>{for(const [id,values,expected]of[[2089,[0,.2,.4,.6,.8],[0,1,2,3,4]],[2105,[.8,.8,.8,.8,.8],[4,4,4,4,4]]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});let rolls=0;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>values[rolls++];},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(rolls,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).barrier,id===2105);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).shield,true);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版小数四舍五入、倒置从小到大、超上限钳制按已答真实提交
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版小数四舍五入、倒置从小到大、超上限钳制按已答真实提交',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['fraction','inverted','overmax']){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:mode==='inverted'?3000:1000},hp:mode==='fraction'?450:mode==='inverted'?1500:1000}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(20267)];wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>.999;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.round,2);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp');assert.ok(event.sampled.every(n=>n===event.upper));assert.deepEqual(event.after,s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>Math.min(event.upper,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp)));}});

success.name: 4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['four','five','immune','zero']){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}}),f=s.fighters[0],enemy=s.fighters[1],lost=mode==='four'?4:5;f.pp[key(10006)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)].pp-lost+1;if(mode==='immune')enemy.counts.immune=1;if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10006,20117);const actual=s.fighters[0],foe=s.fighters[1],event=actual.soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-'));assert.equal(event.lost,lost);assert.equal(!!foe.ailments['神游'],mode==='five'||mode==='zero');assert.equal(foe.pp[key(20117)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].pp-(mode==='four'?5:mode==='immune'?1:0));}});

success.name: 4902真实两版命中PP削减遵守PP保护、所选药剂没有PP槽不转移到其他技能；神游失败不扣PP补偿
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中PP削减遵守PP保护、所选药剂没有PP槽不转移到其他技能；神游失败不扣PP补偿',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const potion of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});timer(s,1,'PP保护');turn(s,10006,potion?null:20117);for(const k of s.fighters[1].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-(!potion&&k===key(20117)?1:0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='hit-pp').reduced,0);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版下一回合固粉增伤25%不增真实伤害，护盾护罩同源重授刷新、异源保留合计
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版下一回合固粉增伤25%不增真实伤害，护盾护罩同源重授刷新、异源保留合计',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1000},hp:500});turn(s);let initialShield=s.fighters[0].suitState.shield;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.refreshShield(c.a,77,'independent4902');c.refreshBarrier(c.a,33,'independent4902');c.hurt(c.t,100,'固定验证','fixed');c.hurt(c.t,100,'百分比验证','percent');c.hurt(c.t,100,'真实验证','true');}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),125);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),125);assert.equal(sum(s,'true'),100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.shield,initialShield+77);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].suitState.barrier,283);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版随机PP变更的削减遵守公共PP免疫；获得的回合免异不消耗次数并于真实下回合阻止异常
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版随机PP变更的削减遵守公共PP免疫；获得的回合免异不消耗次数并于真实下回合阻止异常',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});timer(s,0,'PP保护');const before=s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]);turn(s);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),before.map((n,i)=>n-(i===0?1:0)));const a=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1000},hp:500});turn(a);a.fighters[0].counts.immune=2;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)assert.equal(c.ailment(c.a,'星赐',c.t,false,false,3),false);},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['星赐'],undefined);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].counts.immune,2);}});

success.name: 4902真实2089和2105普通多段技能魂印只触发一次；控制未用、药剂、MISS均无命中PP或神游分支
success.assertion: test('4902真实2089和2105普通多段技能魂印只触发一次；控制未用、药剂、MISS均无命中PP或神游分支',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const a=V(id).make({move:11409,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(a,11409,20117);assert.ok(a.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length>=2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.filter(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-')).length,1);for(const mode of['control','potion','miss']){const b=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400},hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='control')b.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='miss')timer(b,0,'攻击必失');turn(b,mode==='potion'?null:10006,20117);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.filter(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-')).length,0);}}});

success.name: 4902真实两版神游按公共异常机制免疫不补偿且结束转失神，目标实际行动仍被控制
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版神游按公共异常机制免疫不补偿且结束转失神，目标实际行动仍被控制',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});s.fighters[0].pp[key(10006)]-=4;turn(s,10006,20117);const end=s.fighters[1].ailments['神游'];assert.ok(end===2||end===3);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].pp);s.fighters[0].soulId=null;for(let r=2;r<=end;r++)turn(s,null,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['神游'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['失神']);}});

success.name: 4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态
success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.name: 4902真实两版先手命中削减已选技能最后1PP令对手实际未用出，不另选其他槽且无神游
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版先手命中削减已选技能最后1PP令对手实际未用出，不另选其他槽且无神游',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)]=1;turn(s,10006,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['神游'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);for(const k of s.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>k!==key(20117)))assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版固粉增伤只有下一回合，之后不再满足护罩阈值则不续期，第三回固定回复原100
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版固粉增伤只有下一回合，之后不再满足护罩阈值则不续期，第三回固定回复原100',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1000},hp:500});turn(s);s.fighters[0].hp=300;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,100,'增伤期限固定','fixed');if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>0;old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),125);turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),100);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}}});

success.name: 4902已答两版随机端点：四舍五入、m大于n按n到m抽，含端点逐槽五次独立统一随机，原始样本高于上限只钳制不重抽
success.assertion: for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const [maxHp,hp]of[[9000,45],[9000,50],[9000,149],[9000,150],[9000,4500],[900,449],[900,450],[450,200]]){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,aStats:{maxHp},hp,seed:Math.imul(hp,0x9e3779b1)>>>0}),{values}=capture(()=>turn(s,21021,20117)),event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp'),m=Math.round(Math.min(hp,maxHp-hp)/100),n=Math.round(Math.min(10,Math.max(hp,maxHp-hp)/100)),lo=Math.min(m,n),hi=Math.max(m,n);assert.equal(event.m,m);assert.equal(event.n,n);assert.equal(event.lower,lo);assert.equal(event.upper,hi);assert.equal(values.length,5);assert.deepEqual(event.sampled,values.map(u=>lo+Math.floor(u*(hi-lo+1))));assert.deepEqual(event.after,s.fighters[0].moves.map((k,i)=>Math.min(event.sampled[i],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp)));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),event.after);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}

 for(const id of[2089,2105]){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,seed:1});timer(s,0,'PP保护');turn(s,21021,20117);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp');assert.deepEqual(event.after,event.before.map((before,i)=>Math.max(before,Math.min(event.sampled[i],s.moveDefinitions[s.fighters[0].moves[i]].pp))));}

boundary.name: 4902已答两版随机端点：四舍五入、m大于n按n到m抽，含端点逐槽五次独立统一随机，原始样本高于上限只钳制不重抽
boundary.assertion: for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const [maxHp,hp]of[[9000,45],[9000,50],[9000,149],[9000,150],[9000,4500],[900,449],[900,450],[450,200]]){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,aStats:{maxHp},hp,seed:Math.imul(hp,0x9e3779b1)>>>0}),{values}=capture(()=>turn(s,21021,20117)),event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp'),m=Math.round(Math.min(hp,maxHp-hp)/100),n=Math.round(Math.min(10,Math.max(hp,maxHp-hp)/100)),lo=Math.min(m,n),hi=Math.max(m,n);assert.equal(event.m,m);assert.equal(event.n,n);assert.equal(event.lower,lo);assert.equal(event.upper,hi);assert.equal(values.length,5);assert.deepEqual(event.sampled,values.map(u=>lo+Math.floor(u*(hi-lo+1))));assert.deepEqual(event.after,s.fighters[0].moves.map((k,i)=>Math.min(event.sampled[i],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp)));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),event.after);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}

let crossed=false,clipped=false;for(const id of[2089,2105])for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s,21021,20117);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp'),actual=event.after.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),raw=event.sampled.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);assert.equal(event.sum,actual);assert.equal(event.barrier,actual>=(id===2089?25:20));assert.equal(event.shield,actual<=(id===2089?25:30));if(event.barrier)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.outputRound,2);if(event.shield)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['免异常'].start,2);clipped||=event.after.some((n,i)=>n<event.sampled[i]);crossed||=id===2089&&raw>=25&&actual<25;}assert.equal(clipped,true);assert.equal(crossed,true);
 for(const id of[2089,2105]){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,seed:1});timer(s,0,'PP保护');turn(s,21021,20117);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp');assert.deepEqual(event.after,event.before.map((before,i)=>Math.max(before,Math.min(event.sampled[i],s.moveDefinitions[s.fighters[0].moves[i]].pp))));}

interaction.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

interaction.name: 4902真实两版固粉增伤只有下一回合，之后不再满足护罩阈值则不续期，第三回固定回复原100
interaction.assertion: test('4902真实两版固粉增伤只有下一回合，之后不再满足护罩阈值则不续期，第三回固定回复原100',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1000},hp:500});turn(s);s.fighters[0].hp=300;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.hurt(c.t,100,'增伤期限固定','fixed');if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>0;old.run(e,c);}};try{turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),125);turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),100);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}}});

interaction.name: 4902已答两版随机端点：四舍五入、m大于n按n到m抽，含端点逐槽五次独立统一随机，原始样本高于上限只钳制不重抽
interaction.assertion: for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const [maxHp,hp]of[[9000,45],[9000,50],[9000,149],[9000,150],[9000,4500],[900,449],[900,450],[450,200]]){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,aStats:{maxHp},hp,seed:Math.imul(hp,0x9e3779b1)>>>0}),{values}=capture(()=>turn(s,21021,20117)),event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp'),m=Math.round(Math.min(hp,maxHp-hp)/100),n=Math.round(Math.min(10,Math.max(hp,maxHp-hp)/100)),lo=Math.min(m,n),hi=Math.max(m,n);assert.equal(event.m,m);assert.equal(event.n,n);assert.equal(event.lower,lo);assert.equal(event.upper,hi);assert.equal(values.length,5);assert.deepEqual(event.sampled,values.map(u=>lo+Math.floor(u*(hi-lo+1))));assert.deepEqual(event.after,s.fighters[0].moves.map((k,i)=>Math.min(event.sampled[i],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp)));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),event.after);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}

interaction.name: 4902已答上限后阈值：盾罩与下回合增伤免异按实际PP，原始抽样越上限不重抽；保护只阻已知PP降低路径
interaction.assertion:
let crossed=false,clipped=false;for(const id of[2089,2105])for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s,21021,20117);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp'),actual=event.after.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),raw=event.sampled.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);assert.equal(event.sum,actual);assert.equal(event.barrier,actual>=(id===2089?25:20));assert.equal(event.shield,actual<=(id===2089?25:30));if(event.barrier)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.outputRound,2);if(event.shield)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['免异常'].start,2);clipped||=event.after.some((n,i)=>n<event.sampled[i]);crossed||=id===2089&&raw>=25&&actual<25;}assert.equal(clipped,true);assert.equal(crossed,true);
 for(const id of[2089,2105]){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,seed:1});timer(s,0,'PP保护');turn(s,21021,20117);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp');assert.deepEqual(event.after,event.before.map((before,i)=>Math.max(before,Math.min(event.sampled[i],s.moveDefinitions[s.fighters[0].moves[i]].pp))));}

review.rationale: 两项回答补齐小数、倒置和抽样超上限边界；两版保留真实hash和25/20/30阈值，统一随机逐槽独立，不以超上限原样本算增益。
review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.singleBehavior: 回合结束按当前/已损体力计算m/n并四舍五入，按较小到较大端点含两端逐槽各抽一次，超过原技能PP上限即钳制；保留当前PP降低保护；按实际总PP与实际已损授盾罩、下回合免异/固粉增伤，命中PP/神游行为保持。

success.name: 4902两版20/25/30阈值四个实际总和20/25/30/35分开检验，强化版30同时授盾罩而原版只有罩
success.assertion: test('4902两版20/25/30阈值四个实际总和20/25/30/35分开检验，强化版30同时授盾罩而原版只有罩',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const value of[4,5,6,7]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:value*200},hp:value*100,loadout:[20267,38388,29349,29350,38390]});turn(s);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1);assert.equal(event.sum,value*5);assert.equal(event.barrier,value*5>=(id===2089?25:20));assert.equal(event.shield,value*5<=(id===2089?25:30));}});

success.name: 4902真实2089与2105整数固定区间独立重设五槽，25恰等时两类同时成立且按真实总PP/已损PP授盾罩
success.assertion: test('4902真实2089与2105整数固定区间独立重设五槽，25恰等时两类同时成立且按真实总PP/已损PP授盾罩',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1000},hp:500});turn(s);const f=s.fighters[0],event=f.soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1),missing=f.moves.reduce((n,k)=>n+s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-5,0);assert.deepEqual(f.moves.map(k=>f.pp[k]),[5,5,5,5,5]);assert.equal(event.sum,25);assert.equal(event.barrier,true);assert.equal(event.shield,true);assert.equal(f.suitState.barrier,250);assert.equal(f.suitState.shield,missing*10);assert.equal(f.effects['免异常'].start,2);assert.equal(f.effects['免异常'].end,2);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存',()=>{for(const [id,values,expected]of[[2089,[0,.2,.4,.6,.8],[0,1,2,3,4]],[2105,[.8,.8,.8,.8,.8],[4,4,4,4,4]]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});let rolls=0;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>values[rolls++];},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(rolls,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).barrier,id===2105);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).shield,true);}});

success.assertion: test('4902真实两版小数四舍五入、倒置从小到大、超上限钳制按已答真实提交',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['fraction','inverted','overmax']){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:mode==='inverted'?3000:1000},hp:mode==='fraction'?450:mode==='inverted'?1500:1000}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(20267)];wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>.999;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.round,2);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp');assert.ok(event.sampled.every(n=>n===event.upper));assert.deepEqual(event.after,s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>Math.min(event.upper,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp)));}});

success.name: 4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['four','five','immune','zero']){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}}),f=s.fighters[0],enemy=s.fighters[1],lost=mode==='four'?4:5;f.pp[key(10006)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)].pp-lost+1;if(mode==='immune')enemy.counts.immune=1;if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10006,20117);const actual=s.fighters[0],foe=s.fighters[1],event=actual.soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-'));assert.equal(event.lost,lost);assert.equal(!!foe.ailments['神游'],mode==='five'||mode==='zero');assert.equal(foe.pp[key(20117)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].pp-(mode==='four'?5:mode==='immune'?1:0));}});

boundary.name: 4902两版20/25/30阈值四个实际总和20/25/30/35分开检验，强化版30同时授盾罩而原版只有罩
boundary.assertion: test('4902两版20/25/30阈值四个实际总和20/25/30/35分开检验，强化版30同时授盾罩而原版只有罩',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const value of[4,5,6,7]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:value*200},hp:value*100,loadout:[20267,38388,29349,29350,38390]});turn(s);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1);assert.equal(event.sum,value*5);assert.equal(event.barrier,value*5>=(id===2089?25:20));assert.equal(event.shield,value*5<=(id===2089?25:30));}});

boundary.assertion: test('4902真实2089与2105整数固定区间独立重设五槽，25恰等时两类同时成立且按真实总PP/已损PP授盾罩',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1000},hp:500});turn(s);const f=s.fighters[0],event=f.soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1),missing=f.moves.reduce((n,k)=>n+s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-5,0);assert.deepEqual(f.moves.map(k=>f.pp[k]),[5,5,5,5,5]);assert.equal(event.sum,25);assert.equal(event.barrier,true);assert.equal(event.shield,true);assert.equal(f.suitState.barrier,250);assert.equal(f.suitState.shield,missing*10);assert.equal(f.effects['免异常'].start,2);assert.equal(f.effects['免异常'].end,2);}});

boundary.name: 4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存
boundary.assertion: test('4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存',()=>{for(const [id,values,expected]of[[2089,[0,.2,.4,.6,.8],[0,1,2,3,4]],[2105,[.8,.8,.8,.8,.8],[4,4,4,4,4]]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});let rolls=0;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>values[rolls++];},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(rolls,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).barrier,id===2105);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).shield,true);}});

boundary.assertion: test('4902真实两版小数四舍五入、倒置从小到大、超上限钳制按已答真实提交',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['fraction','inverted','overmax']){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:mode==='inverted'?3000:1000},hp:mode==='fraction'?450:mode==='inverted'?1500:1000}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(20267)];wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>.999;},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.round,2);const event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp');assert.ok(event.sampled.every(n=>n===event.upper));assert.deepEqual(event.after,s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>Math.min(event.upper,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp)));}});

boundary.name: 4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中
boundary.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['four','five','immune','zero']){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}}),f=s.fighters[0],enemy=s.fighters[1],lost=mode==='four'?4:5;f.pp[key(10006)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)].pp-lost+1;if(mode==='immune')enemy.counts.immune=1;if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10006,20117);const actual=s.fighters[0],foe=s.fighters[1],event=actual.soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-'));assert.equal(event.lost,lost);assert.equal(!!foe.ailments['神游'],mode==='five'||mode==='zero');assert.equal(foe.pp[key(20117)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].pp-(mode==='four'?5:mode==='immune'?1:0));}});

boundary.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中PP削减遵守PP保护、所选药剂没有PP槽不转移到其他技能；神游失败不扣PP补偿',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const potion of[false,true]){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});timer(s,1,'PP保护');turn(s,10006,potion?null:20117);for(const k of s.fighters[1].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-(!potion&&k===key(20117)?1:0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='hit-pp').reduced,0);}});

boundary.name: 4902真实两版下一回合固粉增伤25%不增真实伤害，护盾护罩同源重授刷新、异源保留合计

boundary.name: 4902真实两版随机PP变更的削减遵守公共PP免疫；获得的回合免异不消耗次数并于真实下回合阻止异常

boundary.name: 4902真实2089和2105普通多段技能魂印只触发一次；控制未用、药剂、MISS均无命中PP或神游分支
boundary.assertion: test('4902真实2089和2105普通多段技能魂印只触发一次；控制未用、药剂、MISS均无命中PP或神游分支',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const a=V(id).make({move:11409,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(a,11409,20117);assert.ok(a.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length>=2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.filter(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-')).length,1);for(const mode of['control','potion','miss']){const b=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400},hit:mode!=='miss'});if(mode==='control')b.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=3;if(mode==='miss')timer(b,0,'攻击必失');turn(b,mode==='potion'?null:10006,20117);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.filter(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-')).length,0);}}});

boundary.name: 4902真实两版神游按公共异常机制免疫不补偿且结束转失神，目标实际行动仍被控制

boundary.name: 4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态

boundary.assertion: test('4902真实两版先手命中削减已选技能最后1PP令对手实际未用出，不另选其他槽且无神游',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105]){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)]=1;turn(s,10006,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)],0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['神游'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);for(const k of s.fighters[1].moves.filter(k=>k!==key(20117)))assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);}});

interaction.assertion: for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const [maxHp,hp]of[[9000,45],[9000,50],[9000,149],[9000,150],[9000,4500],[900,449],[900,450],[450,200]]){const h=factory({...source,selectedSoulId:id}),s=h.make({soul:true,move:21021,index:-1,loadout,aStats:{maxHp},hp,seed:Math.imul(hp,0x9e3779b1)>>>0}),{values}=capture(()=>turn(s,21021,20117)),event=s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event==='random-pp'),m=Math.round(Math.min(hp,maxHp-hp)/100),n=Math.round(Math.min(10,Math.max(hp,maxHp-hp)/100)),lo=Math.min(m,n),hi=Math.max(m,n);assert.equal(event.m,m);assert.equal(event.n,n);assert.equal(event.lower,lo);assert.equal(event.upper,hi);assert.equal(values.length,5);assert.deepEqual(event.sampled,values.map(u=>lo+Math.floor(u*(hi-lo+1))));assert.deepEqual(event.after,s.fighters[0].moves.map((k,i)=>Math.min(event.sampled[i],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp)));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),event.after);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.name: 4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存',()=>{for(const [id,values,expected]of[[2089,[0,.2,.4,.6,.8],[0,1,2,3,4]],[2105,[.8,.8,.8,.8,.8],[4,4,4,4,4]]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});let rolls=0;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>values[rolls++];},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(rolls,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).barrier,id===2105);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).shield,true);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['four','five','immune','zero']){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}}),f=s.fighters[0],enemy=s.fighters[1],lost=mode==='four'?4:5;f.pp[key(10006)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)].pp-lost+1;if(mode==='immune')enemy.counts.immune=1;if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10006,20117);const actual=s.fighters[0],foe=s.fighters[1],event=actual.soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-'));assert.equal(event.lost,lost);assert.equal(!!foe.ailments['神游'],mode==='five'||mode==='zero');assert.equal(foe.pp[key(20117)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].pp-(mode==='four'?5:mode==='immune'?1:0));}});

success.name: 4902/4真实命中防御特防攻击提升及重复序列、43半体回复、3清弱，33清强、31多段、66实际击败才回复

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.assertion: test('4902/4真实命中防御特防攻击提升及重复序列、43半体回复、3清弱，33清强、31多段、66实际击败才回复',()=>{for(const [id,levels]of[[20267,{acc:1}],[21021,{def:2,spd:2}],[17074,{atk:2}]]){const s=make({move:id});turn(s,id,null);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(levels))assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],v);}const a=make({move:20375,hp:1000});turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,5500);const b=make({move:17076});b.fighters[0].stages.def=-3;turn(b,17076,null);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].stages.def,0);const c=make({move:17075});c.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(c,17075,null);assert.equal(c.fighters[1].stages.def,0);const d=make({move:11409});turn(d,11409,null);assert.ok(d.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length>=2);for(const dead of[false,true]){const e=make({move:10771,hp:1000,targetHp:dead?1:9000});turn(e,10771,20117);assert.equal(e.fighters[0].hp,dead?4000:1000);}});

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.assertion: test('4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存',()=>{for(const [id,values,expected]of[[2089,[0,.2,.4,.6,.8],[0,1,2,3,4]],[2105,[.8,.8,.8,.8,.8],[4,4,4,4,4]]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});let rolls=0;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>values[rolls++];},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(rolls,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).barrier,id===2105);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).shield,true);}});

success.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['four','five','immune','zero']){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}}),f=s.fighters[0],enemy=s.fighters[1],lost=mode==='four'?4:5;f.pp[key(10006)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)].pp-lost+1;if(mode==='immune')enemy.counts.immune=1;if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10006,20117);const actual=s.fighters[0],foe=s.fighters[1],event=actual.soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-'));assert.equal(event.lost,lost);assert.equal(!!foe.ailments['神游'],mode==='five'||mode==='zero');assert.equal(foe.pp[key(20117)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].pp-(mode==='four'?5:mode==='immune'?1:0));}});

success.name: 4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版逐槽五次公共随机在整数0到4区间分别抽取，原版低于25只有盾，强化版20边界两类共存',()=>{for(const [id,values,expected]of[[2089,[0,.2,.4,.6,.8],[0,1,2,3,4]],[2105,[.8,.8,.8,.8,.8],[4,4,4,4,4]]]){const s=V(id).make({move:20267,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});let rolls=0;wrap((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterRoundEnd'&&c.a.side===0)c.random=()=>values[rolls++];},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(rolls,5);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].moves.map(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]),expected);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).barrier,id===2105);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.at(-1).shield,true);}});

success.name: 4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中
success.assertion: test('4902真实两版命中后已损PP4仅削减当前所选技能，5转神游且免异失败不改成削PP；红免疫零伤仍命中',()=>{for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const mode of['four','five','immune','zero']){const s=V(id).make({move:10006,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}}),f=s.fighters[0],enemy=s.fighters[1],lost=mode==='four'?4:5;f.pp[key(10006)]=s.moveDefinitions[key(10006)].pp-lost+1;if(mode==='immune')enemy.counts.immune=1;if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(s,10006,20117);const actual=s.fighters[0],foe=s.fighters[1],event=actual.soulState.leib4902.events.find(e=>e.event.startsWith('hit-'));assert.equal(event.lost,lost);assert.equal(!!foe.ailments['神游'],mode==='five'||mode==='zero');assert.equal(foe.pp[key(20117)],s.moveDefinitions[key(20117)].pp-(mode==='four'?5:mode==='immune'?1:0));}});

success.name: 4902/4真实命中防御特防攻击提升及重复序列、43半体回复、3清弱，33清强、31多段、66实际击败才回复
success.assertion: test('4902/4真实命中防御特防攻击提升及重复序列、43半体回复、3清弱，33清强、31多段、66实际击败才回复',()=>{for(const [id,levels]of[[20267,{acc:1}],[21021,{def:2,spd:2}],[17074,{atk:2}]]){const s=make({move:id});turn(s,id,null);for(const[k,v]of Object.entries(levels))assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],v);}const a=make({move:20375,hp:1000});turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,5500);const b=make({move:17076});b.fighters[0].stages.def=-3;turn(b,17076,null);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].stages.def,0);const c=make({move:17075});c.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(c,17075,null);assert.equal(c.fighters[1].stages.def,0);const d=make({move:11409});turn(d,11409,null);assert.ok(d.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length>=2);for(const dead of[false,true]){const e=make({move:10771,hp:1000,targetHp:dead?1:9000});turn(e,10771,20117);assert.equal(e.fighters[0].hp,dead?4000:1000);}});

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.assertion: test('4902/408同版已确认整回合共享红减100，固定不减；3回合到期；191反弹与10麻痹成功失败免疫',()=>{const s=make({move:23897,index:0}),b=make({move:23897,index:-1});turn(s,23897,10716);turn(b,23897,10716);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),Math.max(0,sum(b,'attack',1)-100));assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['伤害定额减免'].end,3);const a=make({move:29349,index:0});turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].effects.reflect.end,4);const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const q=make({move:23897,index:1,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(q,23897,null);seen.add(!!q.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[false,true]);});

success.assertion: test('4902/1226红减300使已命中零红仍满足未受正攻击伤害，固定300理论回复受技能禁疗；正完整红伤抑制吸取',()=>{for(const mode of['zero','positive','healban','immune']){const s=make({move:29349,index:1,hp:1000,bStats:{atk:mode==='positive'?5000:180}});if(mode==='healban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,29349,10127);const red=sum(s,'attack',1);assert.equal(red>0,mode==='positive');assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='positive'||mode==='immune'?0:300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000-red+(mode==='positive'||mode==='healban'?0:300));}});

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

review.rationale: 两版魂印和17招当前双方PP、伤害、免疫和盾罩分支逐条保留，已答随机边界当前实现，无虚构多精灵依赖。

review.singleBehavior: 真实技能29350的基础威力、PP、先制、命中、暴击、用招资格；原始有序效果另逐项审核。

success.name: 4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.assertion: test('4902/2031用招基础扣PP后的9对齐双方各槽，实际变化绝对值合计到20才令对手失神和失明，低上限可提升',()=>{const s=make({move:38389,index:1,loadout:[38389,17076,20267,29350,38390]});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=k===key(38389)?10:0);s.fighters[1].moves.forEach(k=>s.fighters[1].pp[k]=0);turn(s,38389,null);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]===9));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(17076)],9);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppAlignment4902[0].own,36);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppAlignment4902[0].enemy,45);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['失神']);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['失明']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['失明'],undefined);const a=make({move:38389,index:1});a.fighters[0].moves.forEach(k=>a.fighters[0].pp[k]=k===key(38389)?10:9);a.fighters[1].moves.forEach(k=>a.fighters[1].pp[k]=9);turn(a,38389,null);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.ppAlignment4902[0].own,0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.ppAlignment4902[0].enemy,0);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].ailments['失神'],undefined);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].ailments['失明'],undefined);});

success.assertion: test('4902全部17招有序编译及64种子基础命中、先制暴击状态，真实两版各17招原生合法PP随机状态',()=>{const H=require('./helpers/remaining-4902.cjs'),E=H.E;for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));const before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]<=before||m.id===38388);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4902 base '+m.id);}for(const id of[2089,2105])for(const m of source.moves){const s=V(id).make({move:m.id,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:400}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.leib4902.events.some(e=>e.event==='random-pp'));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0&&s.fighters[0].pp[k]<=4));}});

success.assertion: test('4902/2073每种实际异常红增50%而固定粉真不机械加，781真实清回合成功才封属性，2075未击败下回禁止解弱反转',()=>{const results=[];for(const n of[0,2]){const s=make({move:38390,index:1});if(n){s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;s.fighters[1].ailments['星哲']=3;}const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let modifier;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)modifier=c.modifier;return r;}};try{turn(s,38390,null);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}results.push(modifier);}assert.equal(results[1],results[0]*2);for(const protect of[false,true]){const a=make({move:38390,index:0});timer(a,1,'doubleDamage');if(protect)timer(a,1,'protect');turn(a,38390,null);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,!protect);}for(const dead of[false,true]){const a=make({move:38390,index:3,targetHp:dead?1:9000});turn(a,38390,20117);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].effects['弱化不可解除反转'],!dead);}});

success.name: 4902/1822实际额外清空PP39不达40、40翻倍且授一次失效，基础费用不混入阈值；免粉仍消费
success.assertion: test('4902/1822实际额外清空PP39不达40、40翻倍且授一次失效，基础费用不混入阈值；免粉仍消费',()=>{for(const cost of[39,40])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38390,index:2});const ks=s.fighters[0].moves;ks.forEach(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]=0);s.fighters[0].pp[key(38390)]=1;s.fighters[0].pp[ks.find(k=>k!==key(38390))]=cost;if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s,38390,null);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]===0));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.ppCost4902[0].cost,cost);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:cost===40?3600:1800);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackInvalid??0,cost===40?1:0);}});

success.name: 4902/2035与1822真实消费绕过PP削减下限保护，归零与实际消耗量不被免削规则虚减
success.assertion: test('4902/2035与1822真实消费绕过PP削减下限保护，归零与实际消耗量不被免削规则虚减',()=>{const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,trait(f,k){return f.side===0&&k==='ppReductionFloor'?{end:99,amount:1}:old.trait(f,k);}};try{const a=make({move:29349,index:2,loadout:[29349,10006,20267,29350,38390]});turn(a,29349,null);a.fighters[0].pp[key(10006)]=3;turn(a,10006,null);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(10006)],0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.windPP2035Last.counted,3);const b=make({move:38390,index:2});turn(b,38390,null);assert.ok(b.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>b.fighters[0].pp[k]===0));assert.ok(b.fighters[0].soulState.ppCost4902[0].cost>=40);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}});

success.name: 4902/2073每种实际异常红增50%而固定粉真不机械加，781真实清回合成功才封属性，2075未击败下回禁止解弱反转
success.assertion: test('4902/2073每种实际异常红增50%而固定粉真不机械加，781真实清回合成功才封属性，2075未击败下回禁止解弱反转',()=>{const results=[];for(const n of[0,2]){const s=make({move:38390,index:1});if(n){s.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;s.fighters[1].ailments['星哲']=3;}const old=E.WIKI.effectsEngine;let modifier;E.WIKI.effectsEngine={...old,run(p,o,c){const r=old.run(p,o,c);if(p==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)modifier=c.modifier;return r;}};try{turn(s,38390,null);}finally{E.WIKI.effectsEngine=old;}results.push(modifier);}assert.equal(results[1],results[0]*2);for(const protect of[false,true]){const a=make({move:38390,index:0});timer(a,1,'doubleDamage');if(protect)timer(a,1,'protect');turn(a,38390,null);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,!protect);}for(const dead of[false,true]){const a=make({move:38390,index:3,targetHp:dead?1:9000});turn(a,38390,20117);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].effects['弱化不可解除反转'],!dead);}});

success.name: 4902/2075真实下回合封清弱与反转，第二回合结束后到期
success.assertion: test('4902/2075真实下回合封清弱与反转，第二回合结束后到期',()=>{const a=make({move:38390,index:3,loadout:[38390,20267,10006,29349,29350]});a.fighters[1].stages.def=-2;turn(a,38390,20117);let cleared;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){cleared=c.clearNegative(c.t);c.rewriteStageValues(c.t,{def:2},'reverse');}},()=>turn(a,20267,20117));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,-2);assert.equal(cleared,false);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].effects['弱化不可解除反转'],undefined);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.clearNegative(c.t);},()=>turn(a,20267,20117));assert.equal(a.fighters[1].stages.def,0);});
